title: Amentum owns parts of EG&G

tellings.quote: I believe if you look in their history uh they own parts of EG&G.

plain: A company called Amentum is said to own parts of EG&G, an older defense contractor. Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower, tells Michels: "I believe if you look in their history uh they own parts of EG&G." He raises it to trace which firms may have inherited secret government work.
